instruction:
Using Obsidian, make a new note with the name "Reading/Podcast Takeaways.md" and set its content to be exactly:

# Podcast Takeaways

Good reminder that most systems fail because upkeep is too heavy.
reference_command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# Podcast Takeaways

Good reminder that most systems fail because upkeep is too heavy.
'); obsidian-cli create "Reading/Podcast Takeaways.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

parameters.expected_content:
# Podcast Takeaways

Good reminder that most systems fail because upkeep is too heavy.
